description:
Define the contract that all reactivity transports implement. Behaviour with these callbacks:

- `subscribe(cell_ref, subscriber, projection_fn) :: {:ok, projected_value} | :disconnected` — subscribe and get the current projected value. Subscriber is opaque (typically {owner_pid, fiber_id, slot_index}).
- `unsubscribe(cell_ref, subscriber) :: :ok` — remove subscription.
- `current(cell_ref, projection_fn) :: projected_value | :disconnected` — read without subscribing.
- (Internal, transport-side) push value updates to subscribers via whatever channel the transport uses. Web target uses messages to owner_pid; in-process transport calls back synchronously.

Plus type specs for Cell.ref, Cell.subscriber, etc.

## TDD
Tests live in test/filament/cell_test.exs and exercise a tiny in-memory test transport that implements the behaviour. Verifies subscribe/unsubscribe/current contract.

## Files
- lib/filament/cell.ex (new)
- test/filament/cell_test.exs (new)
